leadText: Alouette (Japanese: アルメル Armelle) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.
plainText:
Alouette (Japanese: アルメル Armelle) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.

==History==
Alouette first appeared in A Showcase Debut!, where she competed in the Coumarine City Pokémon Showcase. She was first shown grooming her in the preparing room for Pokémon Performers. She was then called onstage as one of the first three Pokémon Performers to perform in the first round, together with and Jessilee. As part of the theme of the first round, "Pokémon Styling", she gave her Furfrou a Pharaoh Trim. It wasn't enough to proceed, however, as she didn't get enough votes from the audience, and thus fell slightly behind Shauna. Afterwards, she was shown talking with Shauna and congratulating her on her victory.

In Master Class Choices!, Alouette competed in the Fleurrh City Pokémon Showcase. Once again, she did not make it to the Freestyle Performance.

In Master Class Is in Session!, Alouette competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase in Gloire City.
